intro.text: A noblewoman living in New Seran.

items.text: Lady Demoux went with her nephew to Lady Kelesina Shores's party in 342. Wax asked for a dance by handing her nephew an introduction card, but before they began, a stranger cut in and danced with Wax herself to question him about his powers.
Wax found Lady Demoux afterwards and apologized at length. She granted him the next dance and spent all of it talking about her hounds.
